paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the Operations & Technology FP&A team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Tracking OCF across all of O&T's business lines is a good way to learn how NBCU runs, and that is a big part of the appeal for me.

At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and reconciliation work where we reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and worked on dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week of reporting.

Consolidating OCF and headcount submissions, reconciling headcount and helping simplify the reporting setup all build on that background. I'm SAP certified and comfortable in Excel and PowerPoint. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
